name: Programming Fundamentals
description: Core programming logic: variables, conditionals, loops, functions, and basic problem decomposition.

name: Python Foundations
description: Python syntax, data types, functions, modules, OOP basics, and the scientific Python ecosystem.

name: Data Structures & Algorithms
description: Arrays, linked lists, trees, graphs, hash maps. Sorting, searching, recursion, time/space complexity.

name: SQL & Databases
description: Relational database concepts, SQL queries, JOINs, GROUP BY, window functions, database design.

name: Mathematics Foundations
description: Functions, sets, algebra, sequences, mathematical notation and proof fundamentals.

name: Statistics & Probability
description: Descriptive stats, probability theory, distributions, Bayes theorem, hypothesis testing, confidence intervals.

name: Linear Algebra
description: Vectors, matrices, dot products, eigenvalues/eigenvectors, matrix decomposition, and transformations.

name: Calculus & Optimization
description: Derivatives, partial derivatives, chain rule, gradient descent, convex optimization.

name: Machine Learning Fundamentals
description: Supervised/unsupervised learning, regression, classification, clustering, feature engineering, cross-validation.

name: Model Evaluation & Tuning
description: Metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, F1, AUC-ROC), hyperparameter tuning, bias-variance tradeoff, regularization.

name: Deep Learning
description: Neural network architectures, backpropagation, CNNs, RNNs, LSTM, attention, Transformers.

name: Natural Language Processing
description: Text preprocessing, word embeddings, language models, BERT/GPT architectures, RAG, fine-tuning.

name: Computer Vision
description: Image processing, CNN architectures, object detection (YOLO, R-CNN), image segmentation, transfer learning.

name: MLOps & Deployment
description: Model serving (FastAPI, TorchServe), Docker, CI/CD pipelines, model monitoring, feature stores.

name: Data Engineering
description: ETL pipelines, data warehousing, Apache Spark, Airflow, dbt, streaming data.

name: Data Visualization
description: Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly, dashboard design, storytelling with data, BI tools.

name: Cloud Platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure)
description: Cloud services (EC2, S3, Lambda), managed ML services (SageMaker, Vertex AI), IAM, networking.

name: Docker & Kubernetes
description: Containerisation with Docker, orchestration with Kubernetes, Helm charts, service meshes.

name: Networking Basics
description: TCP/IP model, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, firewalls, VPNs, subnets, and network architecture.

name: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
description: CIA triad, attack vectors (OWASP Top 10), cryptography, penetration testing basics, SIEM.

name: Web Development Fundamentals
description: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript ES6+, REST APIs, JSON, browser DevTools.

name: Software Engineering Principles
description: SOLID principles, design patterns, TDD, code review, system design, API design, clean architecture.

name: React & Frontend Development
description: React 18, hooks, state management, TypeScript, Vite, component design, and frontend testing.

name: UI/UX Design Principles
description: User research methods, wireframing, prototyping in Figma, usability testing, design systems, accessibility.
